[USER] User inquired about using gluten-free flour as a substitute for wheat flour when making noodles.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant confirmed that gluten-free flour can be used as a substitute for wheat flour when making noodles, but adjustments may be needed, such as adding xanthan gum or other binding agents.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant noted that gluten-free flours tend to absorb more liquid than wheat flour, so additional water may be needed, and it may affect the texture and flavor of the noodles.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended following a gluten-free noodle recipe specifically formulated for gluten-free flour for the best results.  
[USER] User expressed frustration about the adjustments and extra steps involved in using gluten-free flour, suggesting they might stick to regular wheat flour despite potential consequences.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant acknowledged the user's concern and emphasized the importance of avoiding gluten-containing foods if diagnosed with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity, citing serious health consequences.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned that gluten-free alternatives are widely available and can be delicious and healthy.  
[USER] User stated they do not have the time or energy to worry about gluten-free alternatives and have not experienced major problems with wheat flour in the past.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant reiterated that dietary habits are ultimately the user's decision but highlighted that symptoms of gluten intolerance can vary and may not be immediately apparent.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned that gluten-free options are now widely available and easy to find, making healthier choices more accessible.  
[USER] User expressed concern about the cost of gluten-free options, stating that wheat flour is more affordable and accessible, and they would rather take their chances with wheat flour.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant acknowledged the user's concerns about budget and accessibility, noting that gluten-free options have become more widely available and the added cost is minimal compared to potential health benefits.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned that there are many websites and cookbooks dedicated to gluten-free cooking, making it easy to find suitable recipes.
